_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: E. J. W. Gibb (1857-1901). Ottoman Poems translated into English verse in the original forms (Trübner, 1882) and A History of Ottoman Poetry (Luzac, 1900-07), whose five volumes of history carry his verse translations of the poets; vols II-V were edited after his death by Edward G. Browne. Vol. VI (1909) is the Turkish originals and is left out. Hammer-Purgstall's Turkish anthology is on its own shelf. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 84); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check. Bare 'gibb' would also match H. A. R. Gibb (on broadway-travellers), so _surname carries Gibb's initials.
